prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction sticker of a baby giraffe caught mid-cackle. Show it head-on in a tight chest-up crop, with its oversized head tipped back and its tiny forelegs curled up near its chest. The laugh takes over the face: the broad muzzle stretches into a comically wide, frog-like open mouth with a dark red interior and a big pink tongue at the bottom. Two little eyes squint into happy crescents high above the corners of the mouth. Give the giraffe golden-yellow skin, caramel-brown patches, a pale cream muzzle, two short tufted horns, and a visibly long neck. Render it like a soft, rounded 3D cartoon toy with smooth shading and bright, even lighting. Center it on a plain white background with no text or props.
